Title: General availability: Azure DNS in Microsoft Azure Germany

Body.Content:
Azure DNS is now generally available in Microsoft Azure Germany. 

Azure DNS enables Azure customers to host their DNS domains in Azure and manage their DNS records by using the same credentials, APIs, tools, billing, and support as other Azure services. For more details, please visit the Azure DNS documentation site.
